caveats: Actual Qt timeout is passed once into metadata/version calls and checked in three-second communicate slices. Native Store policy adapts saved/displayed n to ceil(clamp(n,1,600)/3)×3 seconds; fixed Ffmpeg::timeout(Duration) intentionally stays precise and overrides live readers. No exact submillisecond or polling-wakeup latency parity is claimed.

Native deadline duration is captured before process spawning; its Instant deadline is constructed after successful spawn/pipe-reader setup, matching the finite subprocess wait contract rather than bounding OS exec/thread admission itself.

The native subprocess regressions use authored POSIX FIFO transports; the reference uses an authored delayed local executable. They exercise real Ffmpeg/HydrusFFMPEG paths, not codec correctness, external network or arbitrary process-tree cleanup.

Retained importer version, local-review metadata and duplicate PSD decode consumers have dedicated timeout boundaries. Import/folder/parser reader construction establishes other routing but does not mean each caller has a dedicated timeout integration regression.
Streaming frame reads retain fixed per-chunk policy and Drop kill/wait; no streaming/player reuse or broader media playback promotion. Non-Store tools keep their default policy.

About uses a bounded saved-policy version call by source; on failure its pre-existing unavailable-version UI remains, unlike the reference diagnostic path string. A dedicated timeout-driven About UI fixture replay is not present.

Weak reader/isolated importer owner tests prove retained tools do not keep Store alive and fallback15s applies after Store loss. Options callbacks legitimately retain their Store while component handles live; this is not an assertion that all GUI handles release Store immediately.

Raw imported 0/601 display/apply normalization and independent/concurrent saves are model/Store tested; real GUI case inputs 0/601 clamp onApply and reopen. Five native PNGs show saved cases 1,600,15,1,600 with concurrently preserved ICC false, while the sole Qt PNG shows 1 with ICC true.

Options hidden edits/Apply are ignored, admitted visible draft surviveshide/show, retired cancelled handles cannotApply after reshow. Save-error handling keeps the editor open by source; no dedicated injected GUI Store-write failure replay exists for this leaf.
Windows and macOS are deferred; this preparation and required publication validation are Linux-only.

Store-loss fallback is exercised for subsequent reader calls. An admitted subprocess keeps its captured duration; cancellation or owner destruction in the middle of an admitted decode is not a separately replayed boundary and must not be inferred from weak reader ownership.

All five current 1200×1800 native Options captures show complete numeric fields/arrows and clear adjacent labels at saved 1/600/15/1/600. This validates the repaired intrinsic numeric height in those recorded captures, not every viewport/platform or the surrounding unselected controls. The reference crop shows timeout 1 with ICC checked, while native cases intentionally preserve ICC false.

Actual Qt recording forwards the real CallLater/background SingleJob and messagepublication and observes real elapsed 5054.124/6002.523ms. Native tests inject this owner clock and call the production tick at 4999/5000/5999/6000ms; these prove deadline admission/order/noearly publication, not physical five-second native timer latency or equality of Qt/native timestamps.

The real native earliest-deadline weak single-shot timer rechecks the monotonic clock and polls owner/dismissal liveness at most 200ms; event-loop delivery can occur later. The actual 250ms popup projection timer is exercised only for Show resumption after durable hidden publication.

Hidden Main refuses new admission while already-admitted deadlines publish to Store; hidden cards remain frozen until Show refresh. Durable native Store jobs/reopen are explicit native behavior, not a claim that Qt persists its transient JobStatus cards.

Exit Cancel, accepted exit, same Main rebind, sole Bound owner drop and hide-before-drop actual Main destruction are separate native regressions; retained old controls cannot resurrect. General multiple-owner/lost-window/event-loop failure combinations are not exhaustively covered.

Store read/write errors retire pending producer work by source, consuming no duplicate deadline; there is no dedicated injected producer Store failure regression. No failure-notification wording parity is claimed.

The actual Qt PNG is a manager crop with two simple cards and “2 messages”/“dismiss all” summary; the native capture is full Main after real Show refresh. This supports card/text/state comparison, not pixel/frame geometry identity or a screenshot proving elapsed deadline.
Only the original make-a-popup-in-five-seconds leaf is selected; other Debug actions, long-popup producer completion or modal/new-page actions receive no extra completion credit.
Windows and macOS are deferred; this preparation and required publication validation are Linux-only.

The weak-window and Owner-drop regressions prove producer retirement without retaining Main. Retained Control handles still own their State and Store until those handles are dropped; this packet does not claim immediate release of every Store owner on GUI retirement.

The current 1000×700 full Main capture shows two complete exact-message cards and “2 messages”/“dismiss all” summary; Qt records its cropped manager. This is after-show consumer evidence, not a picture of physical five-second scheduling.
